patthana8.7:1.1: na appaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaccayo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.7:3.1: na appaccayo dhammo na appaccayassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana8.7:4.1: na sappaccayo dhammo na appaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana8.7:5.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe dve sabbattha vitthāro. na saṅkhatadukaṃ
